tokenName: LuSE Securities Community Grain Receipt Token
underlyingAsset: Certified community grain and produce deposits — Zambia
description: LuSE Securities lists tokenised warehouse receipts from smallholder farmers and rural cooperatives in Zambia. Any farmer with certified stored produce can list their receipt on this exchange, attracting institutional buyers and creating immediate liquidity for rural communities. Minimum lot size is 1 bag of produce.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Warehouse Receipts Act; LuSE Securities Commodity Listing Rules

tokenName: LuSE Securities Digital Service Contract Token
underlyingAsset: Tokenised gig and informal service contracts — Zambia
description: Service workers, artisans, freelancers and gig economy participants in Zambia can tokenise their service contracts on LuSE Securities. Each token represents a verified contract, enabling service workers to attract working capital financing from investors. Electricians, tailors, plumbers and IT contractors all benefit from this financial inclusion instrument.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: LuSE Securities Public Works Employment Token
description: Listed on LuSE Securities, this PPP contract token finances public infrastructure in Zambia — roads, schools, hospitals and clean water. The project commits to local hiring quotas, ensuring 60%+ of construction jobs go to citizens in surrounding communities. Token holders receive revenue-sharing distributions while simultaneously supporting national employment creation.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia PPP Act; Public Works Employment Tokenisation Policy

description: Anyone in Zambia with as little as one unit of local currency can co-own affordable housing through LuSE Securities. The token represents fractional equity in social and affordable housing developments. Rental income is distributed to all token holders, enabling ordinary workers and students to build real estate wealth for the first time.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: LuSE Securities Daily Labor Proof Token
description: Street vendors, market traders, casual workers and informal sector participants in Zambia receive a ProofOfWork token each day their verified economic activity is recorded via mobile phone. Token holders build a verifiable work history that attracts microloans, insurance, and investment. LuSE Securities lists these tokens so impact investors can directly fund the informal economy.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Labour Act; Informal Economy Tokenisation Framework 2024

underlyingAsset: Verified construction and project milestones — Zambia
description: Construction crews, artisan cooperatives, and community contractors in Zambia earn milestone tokens when independent inspectors verify completed project stages. LuSE Securities lists these milestone tokens, allowing impact investors to fund the next stage while workers receive immediate payment for verified work. Reduces unemployment in the construction sector by guaranteeing staged funding.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

description: Smallholder farmers across Zambia access crop financing through tokens listed on LuSE Securities. Each token represents verified seasonal crop credit extended to registered farmers. Investors earn returns from harvest proceeds while farmers gain pre-season capital to buy seeds, fertiliser and equipment — breaking the poverty cycle in rural communities.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Agriculture Finance Act; Capital Markets Agricultural Token Rules

underlyingAsset: Micro and small enterprise investment — Zambia
description: Market stall operators, street vendors, home-based producers and micro-enterprises in Zambia list their businesses as investable tokens on LuSE Securities. Ordinary people become investors in their neighbours' businesses. Token holders receive profit distributions from the SME pool. Minimum investment is the price of one cup of tea — true financial inclusion.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: LuSE Securities All-Inclusive Market ETF Token
underlyingAsset: Broad market ETF accessible to all investors — Zambia
description: This ETF token on LuSE Securities pools capital from all income levels — from a domestic worker saving monthly wages to a pension fund — into a single diversified portfolio. Tracking the full Zambia market including SMEs, REITs, bonds and commodity tokens. Minimum investment is one token. Automated rebalancing ensures optimal exposure across all 15 asset token categories.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

description: Any citizen of Zambia with a mobile phone and a DID-verified digital wallet can buy fractional shares in any company listed on LuSE Securities via this digital equity token. Previously only available to wealthy investors and institutions, listed equity is now accessible from as little as one unit of local currency. Promotes broad-based wealth creation.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: LuSE Securities Retail Government Bond Token
underlyingAsset: Fractional government bond for retail investors — Zambia
description: Government bonds in Zambia, formerly requiring minimum investments of thousands, are now accessible via LuSE Securities from as little as one currency unit. Every salary earner, market vendor and smallholder farmer can invest their savings in sovereign fixed-income instruments and earn consistent returns previously reserved for banks and large institutions.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Markets Act; Zambia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: LuSE Securities Financial Inclusion Universal Token
description: The LuSE Securities Financial Inclusion token bridges formal and informal economies in Zambia. It represents a basket of community micro-investments — market women's cooperatives, youth enterprise groups, disability enterprise clusters, and informal savings groups (chamas/susus). No minimum investment. Designed to give every adult a stake in the national economy.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Financial Inclusion Strategy; National Digital Economy Policy 2024

tokenName: LuSE Securities Artisanal Mining Community Token
underlyingAsset: Artisanal and small-scale mining output — Zambia
description: Artisanal and small-scale miners (ASM) in Zambia tokenise their verified mineral output through LuSE Securities. Copper, gold, cobalt, lithium and other critical minerals mined by community cooperatives attract institutional and retail investment. Miners receive fair market prices immediately while investors gain exposure to commodity markets. Reduces exploitation of artisanal miners.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Mines and Minerals Act; Artisanal Mining Tokenisation Policy

tokenName: LuSE Securities Smallholder Harvest Verification Token
description: Smallholder farmers in Zambia earn AgriPoW tokens when satellite imagery, IoT soil sensors and field agents verify their planting, growing and harvest activities. LuSE Securities lists these tokens, allowing impact investors and agri-funds to directly reward verified agricultural output. Farmers build a verifiable credit history that unlocks loans, insurance and investment — without traditional collateral requirements.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Agriculture Act; Digital Agriculture Proof-of-Work Standards

tokenName: LuSE Securities Community Supply Chain Token
underlyingAsset: End-to-end community supply chain tracking — Zambia
description: From the smallholder farm gate to the urban market stall, LuSE Securities issues supply chain tokens at every verified step. Market women, transporters, processors, and retailers all earn tokens for their verified role in the supply chain. Investors gain transparent exposure to the real economy. Supply chain financing reduces post-harvest losses and creates stable employment.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Trade Act; National Supply Chain Tokenisation Framework
